title: New Relic License key: one-property twin (boundary) (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: the value is continued by one identifier character after NRAL (basis: provider). Twin of "New Relic License key: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
